name: stage_1_stand_symmetric
description: Stand to a symmetric base first (E1b fr_blend on, homeo OFF), advance at ~80s.  The per-tick brain forms the dynamically-stable stance before the per-step walking signal turns on.

name: stage_2_homeokinetic_walk_norm
description: (a) homeo per-step reward + upright term + SELF-CALIBRATING PAYOUT NORM.  The upright multiplier alone (homeo_upright arm) suppressed the knee-fold Goodhart but halved the payout below the ~30% ignition share -> rhythm decayed to baseline.  homeo_payout_norm=1 divides the reward by the running-mean upright factor (EMA over touchdowns, floor 0.1) so steps CLEANER than the robot's recent average pay MORE than ignition level, dirtier ones pay less -> the anti-Goodhart gradient survives without de-funding the rhythm.
